production.title: OpenAPI Specification - Exa
production.bodyText:
You can view up-to-date versions of our OpenAPI specs here:
Public API Spec: YAML · JSON
Team Management API Spec
The raw OpenAPI specs are the source of truth for request and response schemas. Generated reference pages may omit recipes, migration notes, and recommended defaults; use the guides and examples for current integration guidance such as type: "auto", highlights, and freshness settings. These links always point at the specs served by this docs deployment.
